verdict.rationale: Dynadot's own docs say it offers search and registration across more than 600 domain extensions, plus IDN search and multi-TLD bulk search, which covers the breadth half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows per-TLD documentation of special requirements for restricted or country-code TLDs. Missing for 10: per-TLD documentation of restricted/ccTLD registration requirements, independent or hands-on corroboration of TLD coverage.

support.subject: As a power user, the registrar carries the TLDs I actually want — hundreds of extensions with any special requirements (restricted TLDs, country codes) documented per TLD

citations.quote: Search, discover, and register from over 600 domain extensions.
Search available Internationalized Domain Names (IDNs) and register today.
Paste a list of names, pick your TLDs, and see what is available in seconds.
